name: duckassistbot
description: DuckDuckGo's real-time fetcher for DuckAssist answers, which cite their sources. Classifies as agent/duckduckgo from the User-Agent alone, at medium confidence. The User-Agent is transcribed verbatim from DuckDuckGo's published documentation (https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/results/duckassistbot, fetched 2026-09-28): no `Mozilla/` prefix and an unusual `; (` separator, both as printed. It is not captured from our own traffic, and the other headers are illustrative.
